component.name: Simple Modern Equalizer
component.summary: System-wide audio equalizer for headphones and speakers

description.p: Adjust bass, midrange, and treble across your PipeWire session. Load a headphone preset or import Equalizer APO settings to start from an existing tuning.
Use the parametric or spline editor to shape the response in more detail. The live monitor can show the signal before and after EQ.

screenshot.caption: Parametric equalizer and live audio monitor
